rules.execution_status: The reviewed upstream tool package declares torchnep.train. The AIMatterLab built-in worker engine list has no TorchNEP adapter. Consult the explicitly selected package and target for the operations it actually exposes.
basic: actual train and explicit validation/heldout assets
NEP4 regular energy model only for reliable baseline
scratch initialization, text weight restart or a full epoch-boundary checkpoint
explicit source-compatible architecture/cutoffs and target consumer
readiness_hazards: --val-fraction is reserved. Without a validation file the trainer skips validation. Keep an independent final test set.

--restart loads weights from nep.txt. --resume checkpoint.pt restores the saved model, optimizer, scheduler, history, RNG and data identity. --epochs is the total target epoch. Relocated training and validation data must match.

For fresh runs the default is CUDA float32 and cuda-graph. Selecting CPU defaults to eager. Full resume restores the recorded training settings. CUDA Graph training requires a supported regular NEP4 configuration.
The generation value in nep.in can supply the epoch count. population does not set the Adam batch size. Check actual CLI and nep.in precedence.

The upstream source describes partial qNEP support and bounded small-system derivative checks. Charge/BEC-labelled losses and real-data convergence require separate evidence. Flexible ZBL and charge modes are outside the reviewed CUDA Graph path.
Explicit MD export targets check the NEP layout. The default torchnep write target establishes model persistence. Verify the target engine separately.
The checked source belongs to the TorchNEP repository and revision in the source receipt. Inspect a different selected revision before adopting its CLI settings.

rules_zh-CN: 核对实际选用的 TorchNEP 源码与版本。新训练默认 CUDA、float32 和 CUDA Graph；显式选 CPU 默认使用 eager。
文本势用 --restart 接续权重；完整 checkpoint.pt 用 --resume 恢复训练状态，--epochs 为总目标轮数。缺少验证文件会跳过验证。
上游工具交付声明 torchnep.train。用当前登记的交付和目标环境核对可用操作，内置 worker 没有同名引擎。
